By this application under Section 438 of Cr. P.C., the petitioner, namely, Asif Ahamed @ Asif Ahmed is seeking Anticipatory Bail apprehending arrest in connection with an FIR lodged by the informant, which is registered as Tarabari Police Station Case No. 67/2023 under Section 376 of IPC read with Section 8/14 of the Protection of Children from the Sexual Offences Act, 2012, read with Section 66 (E)/67(A) of the Information Technology Act, 2000 and subsequently added Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text:
3. Let up-to-date Case Diary be called for again on 17 th November, 2023.
4.

Meanwhile, in the interim, it is directed that in the event of the arrest of the petitioner, in connection with the aforementioned case, he shall be released on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees thirty thousand) only with one local surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.

The petitioner shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Page No.# 3/3 police station,
without prior written permission from Officer-in-Charge, Tarabari Police Station.
3. That the petitioner shall not hamper or tamper with the investigation in any manner; and 4.

That the petitioner shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person/witness acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer in connection to this Police Station Case.
If any of the conditions are found to be violated by the petitioner then the Investigating Officer shall be at liberty to seek cancellation of the interim bail granted to the petitioner.
5. Accordingly, let this matter be listed again on 17th November, 2023 for up-dated Case Diary along with the statement and medical report, if any.
